subject: Request to rephase close timeline and adjust MAP milestones
messages:
From: Claire Simmons <claire@veridian.ai>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to rephase close timeline and adjust MAP milestones

Hi Ben,

Quick note from procurement — we’ve hit an internal hold tied to a new vendor security questionnaire and a small budget reallocation for Q3. The net effect: our legal/procurement team has asked to push the contract signature window out by ~3 weeks.

We still want to close and move forward; the ask is simply to rephase the remaining MAP milestones so our acceptance & SSO onboarding dates slide accordingly. I attached the procurement notice the team sent (veridian_procurement_notice.pdf).

Can you send an updated MAP with adjusted milestone dates and a short note on whether we can keep the current delivery capacity (no performance degradation) if we shift the acceptance window? We have a hard dependency on the analytics pilot starting 4 weeks after signature, so we’re trying to avoid that slipping.

Thanks — Claire
Claire Simmons
Head of Procurement | Veridian HealthTech
claire@veridian.ai

---
Attachment: veridian_procurement_notice.pdf (pdf, 42 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Simmons <claire@veridian.ai>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to rephase close timeline and adjust MAP milestones

Hi Claire —

Thanks for the heads up and for attaching the procurement note. We can absolutely accommodate a short slide of the signature date without impacting reserved capacity, provided we lock the updated milestone dates into the MAP and sign an SOW amendment that reflects the change.

What I’m proposing (attached: proposed_MAP_v3.xlsx):
- Phase A (contract signature -> SSO + sandbox): shift by 21 days (new target: 2027-04-12)
- Phase B (pilot analytics start): preserve the 4-week offset after signature (new target: 2027-05-10)
- Phase C (production cutover): pushed by 21 days to align with procurement window (new target: 2027-06-01)

Operational note: we will honor the current dedicated capacity bucket for the duration of the slide. If procurement needs more time beyond 30 days, capacity and pricing will need to be revisited.

Two asks from my side:
1) Please confirm procurement will accept an SOW amendment (short addendum) and DocuSign route for the signature.
2) If you need us to hold capacity beyond 30 days, let us know now so I can route the pricing exception.

I’m looping Priyom and Mina to help with the SOW changes and onboarding sequencing. I’ll schedule a 30-minute working session tomorrow to walk through the updated MAP if that helps.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: proposed_MAP_v3.xlsx (xlsx, 18 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request to rephase close timeline and adjust MAP milestones — escalation + decision asks

Team,

Forwarding Claire’s procurement note and my proposed MAP (attached). Short summary and asks:

Summary:
- Veridian needs a 21-day slide on signature due to a new internal questionnaire and a small Q3 budget shuffle.
- They want to keep the pilot start relative to signature (i.e., 4 weeks after).
- Ben proposed a 21-day slide and a short SOW addendum.

Decision & support asks (need replies by EOD 16 Mar):
1) Pricing exception: authorize a one-time holding credit to keep committed capacity for 30 days while procurement completes review. Suggested approach: 10% credit on first-month invoice or a $X service credit. Owner: Priyom.
2) Legal: prepare a short SOW amendment (one-page addendum) that only adjusts milestone dates and preserves current terms. Owner: Mina.
3) Ops/Onboarding: confirm we can preserve dedicated capacity and the onboarding slot if signature moves by 21 days. If there’s a scheduling conflict with planned capacity in the same week, flag immediately. Owner: Neha.
4) Exec alignment: if procurement asks for >30-day hold, we need an exec-level approval for extended holding and pricing changes.

Please add any risks I missed. I’ll run the 30-minute MAP walk-through with Claire tomorrow at 10:00 PT; invite is out.

Ben

Subject: Re: Request to rephase close timeline and adjust MAP milestones

Ben —

Thanks for the quick turn on the MAP and for holding capacity. We’re comfortable proceeding with the 21-day slide and the SOW addendum you proposed. Confirming the revised milestones below (per proposed_MAP_v3.xlsx):
- Signature target: 2027-04-12
- SSO + sandbox complete: 2027-04-26
- Pilot analytics start: 2027-05-10
- Prod cutover target: 2027-06-01

Two follow-ups from procurement:
1) Please send the SOW addendum via DocuSign (procurement prefers a single signature route for speed).
2) We may need the brief security questionnaire responses before signature — can you provide the SOC2 summary and data handling checklist as a single PDF? If you can attach both to the DocuSign packet, procurement can sign faster.

Appreciate the credit offer on the table — procurement will review the proposed holding credit and circle back if they need it codified in the SOW.

Claire
